culture.text: A 100% ABN AMRO subsidiary, founded in 2017, giving entrepreneurs a business loan offer within 15 minutes.
About 168 employees in Amsterdam; staff often studied economics or computer science at University of Amsterdam, HvA or VU.
Engineering is the biggest job function, followed by business development and IT.
